releases.name: v0.4.2 — TTFT in the footer, dashboard escape, cache rounding
releases.body:
Time to first token can now sit in the compact footer, the dashboard closes with Escape, and
the cache hit rate no longer reads 100% before the whole prompt is cached.

### Added

- **Time to first token in the compact footer** (#14, @cardin). Turn it on with
  `showTtft: true` or `TPS_METER_SHOW_TTFT=true` to see `ttft 1.2s` next to the rate on v2.
  Off by default.

### Fixed

- **The dashboard closes with `escape` or `q`** (#13, @cardin) and returns you to where you
  opened it.
- **The cache hit rate no longer rounds up to 100%** (#15, @Karl-Dai). A prompt that isn't
  fully cached reads at most 99%.

### Docs

- README updated with the footer and toast as they appear, the configuration priority, and
  troubleshooting.

### Notes

- New config option: `showTtft` (default `false`), env `TPS_METER_SHOW_TTFT`.
- The `format` option is accepted but does not change the display yet.
- Thanks to @cardin and @Karl-Dai for the contributions.

releases.name: v0.4.1 — Accurate TPS, subagent throughput, cache hit rate, theme colors
releases.body:
Throughput readings are now accurate, and the footer gains subagent throughput, the prompt
cache hit rate and live theme colors.

### Accurate throughput

- **No more spikes.** Readings no longer jump to thousands of TPS at the start of a reply, or
  stay that way on a finished subagent.
- **The live rate is right from the start**, instead of beginning at 100 TPS and climbing for
  several seconds on fast models.
- **Averages reflect what actually streamed**, so reasoning the provider doesn't show can no
  longer inflate them.
- **Tool calls count as output** (v2). Text the model writes for a tool call, such as a file
  write or an edit, is part of its rate.
- **Calibration is remembered per model** (v2), so new sessions start with an accurate
  estimate.
- **A stalled stream shows its rate falling** instead of holding its last value.
- **The v1 toast** always shows the main session on its main line and no longer skips
  updates.
- **Dashboard.** `gen` is replaced by `tools`, the time a turn spent running tools.
  Per-model stats start fresh.
- Subagents with the same name get a short id, e.g. `explore(9B5c)`.

### Added

- **Multi-session footer** (#8, @ondrejch). While subagents run, the footer shows each one's
  rate and the total, e.g. `TPS Σ 318 | main 63 | explore 91 | +2`, on v1 and v2.
- **Prompt cache hit rate** (#9, @Anigx). The footer shows `cache N% · session cache N%`: the
  share of the prompt served from cache for the last step and for the session. It also appears
  in the v2 dashboard and the v1 toast.

### Fixed

- **Theme colors on v2** (#10, @dragonish). The meter uses your theme's colors and follows a
  theme switch without a restart.
- **Cache figures after a tool-call-only step** update instead of showing the previous step's
  numbers.

### Notes

- New config option: `showCacheHit` (default `true`), env `TPS_METER_SHOW_CACHE_HIT`.
- Thanks to @ondrejch, @Anigx and @dragonish for the contributions.

releases.name: v0.4.0 - OpenCode v2 support (stable)
releases.body:
﻿## v0.4.0 — OpenCode v2 support (stable)

Promotes `v0.4.0-beta.1` to stable with loader fixes verified end to end against
OpenCode **2.0.2**: the server reports
`"features":{"server":true,"tui":true},"state":{"status":"active"}` for the
plugin, and the meter renders in the TUI prompt footer. Install with
`opencode-tps-meter@latest`. Everything in the beta.1 notes below carries over.

### 🐞 Fixed since beta.1

- **Removed the `tui: true` flag from the server plugin definition.** The loader
  treats any `tui` key as a legacy handler and throws
  `Plugin <spec> has invalid tui export` on a non-function, aborting the whole
  plugin load with no meter.
- **`./server` resolves to the dual-host `dist/index.mjs` again** (`{ id, server,
  setup }`), the only shape valid on both loaders. The v2-only
  `dist/v2/server.mjs` (`{ id, setup }`) fails the v1 `server()` requirement.
  The `/v2` exports remain for programmatic `import` only.
- **Local `file://` installs must target `<package>/dist`, not the repo root.**
  The 2.0.2 resolver handles local directories by file path (`<dir>/server`,
  `<dir>/index`, `<dir>/tui`) and ignores `package.json#exports` there, so the
  repo root (no root `index.*`) is silently skipped. `dist/` contains both
  `index.mjs` (server) and `tui.mjs` (TUI).
- A build-invariants regression test now locks both entrypoints against both
  loaders, including a direct guard on `dist/v2/server.mjs`.

### 📝 Notes

- OpenCode 2.x ships its own per-message `tok/s` readout next to each assistant
  reply. To show only this plugin's meter, set `"tps": false` under `session` in
  `cli.json`. To keep the built-in readout instead, run `/tps hidden`.
- Local installs should register `file:///<path>/opencode-tps-meter/dist` in
  `opencode.json` (`plugin`), `cli.json` (`plugins`), and `tui.json` (`plugin`).

releases.name: v0.4.0-beta.1 — OpenCode v2 support (beta)
releases.body:
**Prerelease.** This targets `opencode2`, which is itself beta and whose plugin API is documented as subject to change before 2.0 is stable. Published under the `beta` dist-tag — `latest` stays on 0.3.1.

```bash
npm install opencode-tps-meter@beta
```

## OpenCode v2 support

One package now serves both generations. v1 reads `server`/`tui`, v2 reads `setup`, and **v1 behaviour is unchanged**.

v2 deleted the entire `message.*` event family the meter was built on, so this is a port rather than a version bump:

| v1 | v2 |
|---|---|
| `message.part.delta` (field `text`) | `session.text.delta` |
| `message.part.updated` (reasoning) | `session.reasoning.delta` |
| `message.updated` (completed) | `session.step.ended` |
| `message.updated` (`info.tokens`) | `session.usage.updated` |
| `session.idle` | unchanged |

### New on v2

Measurements v1 could not make, because its events carried no timestamps and `StepStartPart` carried neither model nor agent:

- **Calibrated live rate** — each step compares streamed tokens against the provider's count and learns a per-model correction
- **Generation vs end-to-end TPS** — tool execution subtracted, so a turn that waited on a shell command still reports the model's real rate
- **Time to first token**, measured on the host clock
- **Hidden overhead** — the auto-title and compaction tokens no step reports
- **Per-subagent breakdown** in the sidebar, using the real session tree
- **Durable ledger and `/tps` dashboard**, persisted and shared across windows

### Performance

Delta counting re-read the whole accumulated response on every chunk — O(n²) per response.

| word heuristic | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 186k chars (v2 path) | 10,223 ms | **12.2 ms** |
| 62k chars (v1 path) | 1,571 ms, +11.7 MB | **10.4 ms** |

Live updates were also being dropped by a clock mismatch in the publish throttle: **8 updates at p50 184 ms** over 120 deltas became **120 updates at p50 15.3 ms**.

Both fixes benefit v1 as well.

## Known limitations

- Registering only in `opencode.json` loads the server half but **not** the TUI meter. Point `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` at the built file for now:
  ```json
  { "plugins": ["file:///abs/path/to/opencode-tps-meter/dist/tui.mjs"] }
  ```
- The footer meter is confirmed working on `opencode2` beta. The dashboard, sidebar panel and calibration are covered by tests but have not been exercised in a live TUI.

Feedback welcome — especially from anyone already running opencode2.

## Changes

- Keeps the persistent TUI TPS meter visible when assistant responses transition into tool calls.
- Keeps the latest TUI TPS status visible after idle/non-streaming phases.
- Adds configurable initial display latency with `initialDisplayDelayMs` / `TPS_METER_INITIAL_DISPLAY_DELAY_MS` and a 10ms default.
- Improves live stream token counting and fallback delta/full-part deduplication.
